title: Cyclotomic Ring-LWE Negacyclic CNOT Shift-Orbit Invariance and Wrap-Around Pauli-X Frame
claims: Over R_{2^t} = Z_{2^t}[X]/(X^n + 1), any mod-2 kernel witness generates n valid mod-2 kernel witnesses via cyclic shifts S^r(v) because X^n == -1 == +1 (mod 2).
Applying a Pauli-X sign-flip frame gate on wires that wrap across the X^n = -1 boundary restores exact mod-2^t negacyclic shift equivariance across all n shifts.
favorable_controls: R_8 = Z_8[X]/(X^4 + 1) across all r = 0, 1, 2, 3 shifts
